detail: Playwright seeded a board log with tickets in all five columns. Column order, placement, blocker count 2 and retry count 3 all passed. `werk ticket move r/06 building` exited 2: the ticket verb has only the subverb restore, so there is no command line move and the redraw part could not run. The capability belongs to werk/27 (the ticket move command), not to a listed unbuilt ticket.

A ready ticket with the long title in a narrow column needs 3+ lines; the card clamps to 2 lines with overflow cut, the title attribute holds the full text, and a click opens a drawer beneath the board with the id in the bar and the full title in the heading below.

A building ticket whose session pid is a live process shows a live-dot at the card's top-left corner and the title starts right of the dot. After the process is killed with no session end the dot disappears and the title moves left. A building/merging ticket with no process shows no dot.

Clicking a building ticket shows the live log above the ticket text with timed lines, a sidebar with cites, blockers, retries, checks, stories and touches, and a Decisions section marking the proposed card as a proposal. Clicking the cite opens the map on the card. Folding the sidebar to a rail persists across reload. When the ticket leaves building the live log goes and the text and sidebar stay.
At 600px the board has a sideways scroll, five columns each at least 200px, and scrolling reaches Done. At 1600px the scroll width fits the client width and the columns fill the width.
